pitch:
# A booking page for a hair salon

## 1. People and their journey
**Client** (the only role): a person who wants a hair appointment and prefers not to phone.
- Needs to see: services with durations, open times, and the status of the booking they just made.
- Decides: which service, which day and time, and what contact details to give.
- Path: arrives, picks a service, picks a day, picks a free time, enters name, phone and email, submits, and sees a confirmation screen with status "Requested".

Salon staff, outside the interface, change a booking from requested to confirmed.

## 2. How it looks
A single-column, light, warm booking form, like a simple stepwise appointment page: a salon header followed by stacked numbered cards.

- **Page background**: flat warm off-white (#FAF6F1) filling the screen behind everything.
- **Header**: top, flat deep plum (#4A2545) band with the salon name in white. No other text.
- **Content column**: centred, 640 px wide at most, full width on phones, with cards stacked in order.
- **Step 1 card, Service**: raised white card with a soft shadow, titled "1 Choose a service". Holds one row per service.
- **Service row**: outlined grey (#D9D0C7) with name left, duration ("45 min") right. Hover: border plum. Selected: plum border, pale plum (#F1E4EF) fill, check mark.
- **Step 2 card, Day**: raised white card, titled "2 Choose a day". Shows a horizontal strip of the next 14 days. Locked, greyed, until a service is chosen.
- **Day button**: outlined, weekday over date. Selected: plum fill, white text. Fully booked or closed day: grey text, struck through, disabled.
- **Step 3 card, Time**: raised white card, titled "3 Choose a time". Shows a grid of time buttons. Locked until a day is chosen.
- **Time button**: outlined plum, white fill. Hover: pale plum. Selected: plum fill, white text. Taken: grey fill, grey text, disabled.
- **No-times message**: inside the Time card, grey text "No times left on this day", shown only when the day has no free times.
- **Step 4 card, Your details**: raised white card with Name, Phone and Email fields. Field: outlined grey. Focused: plum border. Invalid after attempted submit: red (#B3261E) border and red message beneath.
- **Summary line**: above the button, plum text, shows the chosen service, day and time once all three are chosen.
- **Book button**: full-width plum fill, white text "Request booking". Pressed: darker plum (#361A33). Disabled until service, time and details are all valid: grey (#CFC7BF). While sending: shows a spinner.
- **Error banner**: above the button, pale red fill with red text, shown if submission fails or the time was just taken.
- **Confirmation screen**: replaces the cards. A white raised card with a green (#2E7D32) check, the booking details, and a status badge "Requested" in amber (#B26A00). A confirmed booking shows a green "Confirmed" badge.
- **New booking link**: plum text link under the confirmation, "Book another appointment".

## 3. How it is used
- Click or tap a service row: selects it, unlocks days, and clears any chosen time.
- Click or tap a day button: selects it and shows that day's times for the service.
- Click or tap a free time button: selects it and updates the summary line.
- Click or tap a taken time or unavailable day: nothing happens.
- Type in Name, Phone and Email: fills the fields; errors clear when corrected.
- Press Tab and Enter or Space: moves between and activates buttons and fields from the keyboard.
- Click or tap Request booking: validates, creates the booking and shows the confirmation.
- Click or tap Book another appointment: returns to an empty form.

## 4. Scope
One loop: choose service, day and time, give contact details, submit, see the confirmation. Left out are staff and stylist assignment, payments and deposits, product sales and loyalty. Notes and accounts are not asked for.

## 5. Things and their states
- **Service**: name, duration in minutes. It has no states.
- **Time slot**: date, start time, and a length that fits the service. It is free, then taken once a booking holds it.
- **Booking**: service, slot, client name, phone and email. It is requested on submit, and confirmed when staff confirm it.

## 6. Rules
- A service must be chosen before days are offered; otherwise the days stay locked.
- Only free slots that fit the service's full duration before closing are shown.
- Changing the service clears the chosen time.
- Past times and past days are not offered.
- Name is required, 2 to 80 characters; otherwise it is refused with a message.
- Phone is required and must be a plausible phone number (7 to 15 digits, optional + and spaces); otherwise it is refused.
- Email is required and must be valid in form; otherwise it is refused.
- Submit is refused until service, time and valid details are present.
- A slot holds only one booking; if it is taken meanwhile, the banner says so, the times refresh, and no booking is made.
- Overlapping slots are taken together with the booked one, so no two bookings overlap.
- A new booking always starts as requested.
- Only staff, outside the interface, can set confirmed; clients cannot change status.
- Double clicks on Request booking create one booking only.
entities_block:
- **Service** (shown to audience: its records are loaded from the API): [id: string, name: string, duration_minutes: int]
- **TimeSlot** (shown to audience: its records are loaded from the API): [id: string, start_datetime: datetime, length_minutes: int]
- **Booking** (created by audience): [id: string, service_id: string, time_slot_id: string, client_name: string, client_phone: string, client_email: string, status: string, submitted_at: datetime]
action_protocol_block:
The rules the product enforces (plan the audience's side of them; the business's own back-office handling is out of view):
- [Days locked until a service is chosen] (Booking): Given no service is chosen When the client views the day step Then no days are offered and the day step stays locked
- [Only slots that fit the full service duration are offered] (TimeSlot): Given a service with a 45 minute duration and a free slot that ends before closing with less than 45 minutes available When the client views times for that day Then that slot is not offered
- [Changing service clears the chosen time] (Booking): Given a service and a time slot are chosen When the client selects a different service Then the chosen time slot is cleared
- [Past days and times are not offered] (TimeSlot): Given the current time is 14:00 today When the client views available days and times Then today's times before 14:00 and all past days are not offered
- [Days offered are the next 14 days] (TimeSlot): Given today is a given date When the client views the day strip Then exactly 14 consecutive days starting from today are offered
- [Fully booked or closed days cannot be chosen] (TimeSlot): Given a day has no free slots for the chosen service When the client clicks that day Then nothing is selected and the day stays disabled
- [Taken times cannot be chosen] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot is held by a booking When the client clicks that time Then nothing happens and no time is selected
- [Name must be 2 to 80 characters] (Booking): Given the client enters a name When the name has fewer than 2 or more than 80 characters Then the name is refused with a message, and when it has 2 to 80 characters it is accepted
- [Phone must be a plausible phone number] (Booking): Given the client enters a phone number When it has 6 digits or 16 digits Then it is refused, and when it has 7 to 15 digits with optional + and spaces Then it is accepted
- [Email must be valid in form] (Booking): Given the client enters an email When it is missing the @ sign or a domain Then it is refused, and when it is well formed Then it is accepted
- [Submission refused without service, time and valid details] (Booking): Given a service and a time are chosen but the email is invalid When the client submits Then no booking is created and submission is refused
- [A slot holds only one booking] (TimeSlot): Given a slot was free when the client chose it and another booking has taken it When the client submits Then no booking is created, the error banner states the time was taken, and the times refresh
- [Overlapping slots are blocked by a booking] (TimeSlot): Given a booking holds 10:00 to 10:45 When the client views times Then any slot overlapping 10:00 to 10:45 is not offered and cannot be booked
- [New booking always starts as requested] (Booking): Given a valid booking request When the client submits Then the booking is created with status requested
- [Only staff can confirm a booking] (Booking): Given a booking with status requested When staff confirm it Then its status becomes confirmed, and when a client attempts to change its status Then the change is refused
- [Double submission creates one booking] (Booking): Given the client has submitted a valid booking When the client clicks Request booking again before confirmation Then only one booking exists
- [Submission failure creates no booking] (Booking): Given valid details and a chosen time When submission fails on the server Then no booking is created and the error banner is shown above the button
- [Confirmation shows the booking's current status] (Booking): Given a booking with status confirmed When the client views its confirmation Then the status badge reads Confirmed
- [Starting a new booking clears the form] (Booking): Given the confirmation screen is shown When the client clicks Book another appointment Then the form has no service, day, time or contact details chosen
- [Day shows times for the chosen service] (TimeSlot): Given a service of 60 minutes is chosen When the client selects a day Then only free times with at least 60 minutes until closing on that day are shown
- [Selecting a free time updates the summary] (Booking): Given a service and a day are chosen When the client selects a free time Then the summary line shows the service, day and time
- [Contact field errors clear when corrected] (Booking): Given the email field shows an error after a submit attempt When the client enters a valid email Then the error message is removed
- [Invalid fields show red border after attempted submit] (Booking): Given the client has attempted to submit with an empty name When the form is displayed Then the name field has a red border and a red message beneath it
- [Day step locked until service chosen] (Service): Given no service is chosen When the page is displayed Then the day card is greyed and locked
- [Time step locked until day chosen] (TimeSlot): Given no day is chosen When the page is displayed Then the time card is locked
- [No-times message when a day has no free times] (TimeSlot): Given a chosen day has no free times for the service When the time card is displayed Then the message No times left on this day is shown in grey
- [Selected service row styling] (Service): Given a service row is selected When the service list is displayed Then the row has a plum border, pale plum fill and a check mark
- [Request button disabled until form is complete] (Booking): Given service and time are chosen but the phone is not yet valid When the button is displayed Then it is grey and disabled
- [Content column width and layout] (Service): Given the page is viewed on a desktop When the layout renders Then the content column is centred and no wider than 640 px
- [Keyboard operation of the booking form] (Service): Given the form is displayed When the client presses Tab and then Enter on a service row Then the service is selected
intent_block:
- Product type: customer_app
- Audience: Hair salon clients booking appointments
- Goal: Let clients see available appointment times and book a hair salon service without phoning the salon.
- Scope: A single booking page where clients choose a service and time slot and submit their contact details to create a booking.
- The model must cover: Services offered and their durations; Available appointment time slots; Client booking requests with contact details; Booking status (requested or confirmed)
- Do NOT model: Staff rosters and stylist assignment; Online payments and deposits; Inventory and product sales; Client loyalty programmes
